terminology_caveats: 学习资料 is an extension umbrella term for generated artifacts, not a verified Google UI label.
Long was not observed for Chinese output on 2026-10-16. 长 is chosen to pair with verified 短.
Explainer, Presenter, visual styles, layout presets, Detail, Quantity and Difficulty options were not verified in zh-CN UI and use context-based translations.
Bricks is interpreted as a toy-brick visual style (积木). Revise if it denotes a brick-wall look.
集合 is used for Collections throughout. Verify against the Gemini Notebook zh-CN collection label when available.
Ellipses use the single Chinese character … consistently. Spaces separate Chinese text from Latin words and placeholders, but not from full-width punctuation.
Collections available: $1 assumes $1 may be a count or list, so no measure word is added.
Gemini Notebook Ready! adds 笔记本 so the notification refers to a notebook rather than the service.
